notes._QCI: 中國的北京、上海、江蘇、浙江四個省市（B-S-J-Z），不是全中國，2018 年起參加。2009、2012 年的上海，2015 年的北京、上海、江蘇、廣東（B-S-J-G）沒有參加 2025 年，OECD 2025 年的報告沒有收
notes._QUA: 烏克蘭能施測的地區：2022 年 27 個裡的 18 個、2025 年 17 個（不含頓內茨克、盧甘斯克、哈爾科夫、札波羅熱、赫爾松、克里米亞等受戰爭影響的地區），不代表全國；2018 年全國的成績沒有收在 OECD 2025 年的報告裡
notes._QKI: 只有伊拉克的庫德斯坦地區參加，而且只有公立學校
notes._QTJ: 只有塔吉克的首都杜尚別參加
notes.CYP: 賽普勒斯政府實際管轄的地區，不含北賽普勒斯
notes.LBN: 2025 年不含受中東衝突影響最大的兩個省
notes.PSE: 2025 年不含受衝突影響最大的學校；為了比較，OECD 把 2022 年的結果依同樣的範圍重算
notes.ALB: 2025 年小規模的學校沒有受測、學校回應率只有 76%，OECD 只有限度地報告、不比較趨勢：歷次的分數照列，「比上一次」「跟 2012 年比」沒有阿爾巴尼亞
notes.USA: 2025 年沒有達到 PISA 的抽樣標準（OECD 標上星號），學校回應率（含遞補）只有 54%，OECD 提醒判讀要特別小心，偏差的方向無法判斷
notes.CAN: 2025 年沒有達到 PISA 的抽樣標準（OECD 標上星號），學校與學生的回應率偏低，OECD 估計分數可能偏高，科學最多約 15 分
notes.NLD: 2025 年沒有達到 PISA 的抽樣標準（OECD 標上星號），學生回應率 78%、排除的學生 9.3%，學生未回應可能讓分數偏差約 11 分
notes.NZL: 2025 年沒有達到 PISA 的抽樣標準（OECD 標上星號），學校回應率（含遞補）只有 52%，OECD 估計平均分數可能高估 10–15 分
notes.NOR: 2025 年沒有達到 PISA 的抽樣標準（OECD 標上星號），排除的學生占 10.4%，分數可能偏高
notes.VNM: 2025 年改用電腦測驗，之前都是紙本，OECD 不比較越南的趨勢，所以只有 2025 年
notes.GTM: 2025 年從紙本改成電腦測驗，跟之前比要小心；2018 年的數字是 2017 年施測的 PISA for Development（給中低所得國家的版本）
notes.PRY: 2025 年從紙本改成電腦測驗，跟之前比要小心；2018 年的數字是 2017 年施測的 PISA for Development（給中低所得國家的版本）
notes.KHM: 2018 年的數字是 2017 年施測的 PISA for Development（給中低所得國家的版本）
notes.ECU: 2018 年的數字是 2017 年施測的 PISA for Development（給中低所得國家的版本）
notes.ZMB: 2018 年的數字是 2017 年施測的 PISA for Development（給中低所得國家的版本）
notes.AZE: 2006、2009、2025 年是全國；2018、2022 年只有首都巴庫參加，OECD 2025 年的報告沒有收
notes.AUT: OECD 2025 年報告的趨勢表沒有列 2009 年的成績（OECD 認為不能跟其他年份比較）
notes.ARG: OECD 2025 年報告的趨勢表沒有列 2015 年的成績（OECD 認為不能跟其他年份比較）
notes.KAZ: OECD 2025 年報告的趨勢表沒有列 2015 年的成績（OECD 認為不能跟其他年份比較）
notes.MYS: OECD 2025 年報告的趨勢表沒有列 2015 年的成績（OECD 認為不能跟其他年份比較）
notes.ESP: OECD 2025 年報告的趨勢表沒有列 2018 年的成績（OECD 認為不能跟其他年份比較）
notes.LUX: OECD 2025 年報告的趨勢表沒有列 2022 年的成績（OECD 認為不能跟其他年份比較）

notesEn._QCI: Four provinces and municipalities of China (Beijing, Shanghai, Jiangsu and Zhejiang), not the whole country; taking part since 2018. Shanghai (2009, 2012) and B-S-J-G (2015) did not take part in 2025 and are not in the OECD's 2025 report
notesEn._QUA: The parts of Ukraine where testing was possible: 18 of 27 regions in 2022 and 17 in 2025 (excluding war-affected areas such as Donetsk, Luhansk, Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson and Crimea), so not the whole country. The 2018 national result is not in the OECD's 2025 report
notesEn._QKI: Only the Kurdistan Region of Iraq took part, and only public schools
notesEn._QTJ: Only Dushanbe, the capital of Tajikistan, took part
notesEn.CYP: The area under the effective control of the Government of the Republic of Cyprus
notesEn.LBN: In 2025, all governorates except the two most affected by the conflicts in the Middle East
notesEn.PSE: In 2025, excluding the schools most affected by conflict; the OECD recalculated the 2022 results with the same coverage for comparison
notesEn.ALB: In 2025 small schools were not tested and the school response rate was 76%, so the OECD reports Albania's results only in a limited way and without trends: scores are shown, but not the changes
notesEn.USA: Did not meet one or more PISA sampling standards in 2025 (marked with an asterisk by the OECD); the school response rate after replacement was 54%, so the OECD urges particular caution; the direction of any bias cannot be determined
notesEn.CAN: Did not meet one or more PISA sampling standards in 2025 (marked with an asterisk by the OECD); low school and student response rates; the OECD estimates scores may be biased upwards by up to about 15 points in science
notesEn.NLD: Did not meet one or more PISA sampling standards in 2025 (marked with an asterisk by the OECD); a student response rate of 78% and exclusions of 9.3%; student non-response could shift scores by about 11 points
notesEn.NZL: Did not meet one or more PISA sampling standards in 2025 (marked with an asterisk by the OECD); a school response rate after replacement of 52%; the OECD estimates mean scores may be overestimated by 10–15 points
notesEn.NOR: Did not meet one or more PISA sampling standards in 2025 (marked with an asterisk by the OECD); 10.4% of students were excluded, which may bias results upwards
notesEn.VNM: Switched to computer-based testing in 2025 after paper tests in all earlier cycles, so the OECD does not compare its trends and only 2025 is shown
notesEn.GTM: Switched from paper to computer-based testing in 2025, so comparisons with earlier years need caution. Figures under 2018 are from the PISA for Development assessment conducted in 2017
notesEn.PRY: Switched from paper to computer-based testing in 2025, so comparisons with earlier years need caution. Figures under 2018 are from the PISA for Development assessment conducted in 2017
notesEn.KHM: Figures under 2018 are from the PISA for Development assessment conducted in 2017
notesEn.ECU: Figures under 2018 are from the PISA for Development assessment conducted in 2017
notesEn.ZMB: Figures under 2018 are from the PISA for Development assessment conducted in 2017
notesEn.AZE: National results in 2006, 2009 and 2025; only the capital, Baku, took part in 2018 and 2022, which is not in the OECD's 2025 report
notesEn.AUT: The trend tables in the OECD's 2025 report do not include 2009 (not considered comparable)
notesEn.ARG: The trend tables in the OECD's 2025 report do not include 2015 (not considered comparable)
notesEn.KAZ: The trend tables in the OECD's 2025 report do not include 2015 (not considered comparable)
notesEn.MYS: The trend tables in the OECD's 2025 report do not include 2015 (not considered comparable)
notesEn.ESP: The trend tables in the OECD's 2025 report do not include 2018 (not considered comparable)
notesEn.LUX: The trend tables in the OECD's 2025 report do not include 2022 (not considered comparable)
